reason: My backlog is small copy and translation jobs, and I just ask Claude for a draft and fix it myself. Paying 55 USDC for a contest where most entries get nothing feels like spec work, and I'm not sending money to an unaudited new product.
objection: Everyone who doesn't win works for free, so good people will skip it. I'd be paying 55 USDC for a pile of entries judged by an AI that I can't check, on a platform nobody has audited.
would_change_my_mind: An independent audit, plus a free first task where I can see the AI judge's scores and reasons on real entries and they beat what I get from Claude in ten minutes.
